title: Tap Line Cleaning Overdue
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tapline:clean
| stats latest(days_since_clean) as days_since_clean by tap
| where days_since_clean>30
| sort - days_since_clean
description: Uses Tap-line maintenance logs telemetry to monitor how long each draft line has gone since cleaning in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for lines that are drifting into flavor or hygiene risk, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tap-line maintenance logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Tap table of days since clean.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how long each draft line has gone since cleaning so you can spot lines that are drifting into flavor or hygiene risk before it becomes annoying.
